purpose: Verify full-flow energy accounting and extra work from the finite material journal
control: No journal cells or journal writes; same moving specks, original event fabric/fixture and same quantized feature-prefix recall supplied in software
interpretation: Matched material-storage comparison, not a comparison to a physically realized cost-free memory device or an unchanged endpoint-only model
energy: Kinetic + continuum elastic + event/journal fabric energy + excess thermal energy; constant thermal baseline cancels
initial_energy: Measure each arm before any time-zero write; retain and report their difference
input_work: Signed threshold-force work + signed breathing-force work + event and journal write work
net_heat: Independent Heun-stage integral of viscous heat + fabric relaxation heat - diversion into directional material storage, plus stroke heat
numerical_residual: Work - (total energy - own initial total energy); never corrected into heat
incremental_precision_screen: Report differential residual / final extra work; require below 1% for quantitative extra-work allocation
time_refinement: Same physical journal schedule and capacity at both integration resolutions; report residual reduction and endpoint comparison
checks: Instantaneous RHS chain-rule total power matches supplied continuous power
Independent thermal and directional-storage rates match source equations
All write jumps account for initial/final energy and heat
Instrumented standard-step journal final state is exactly the previously saved state
Both arms meet the original absolute energy criterion
Compare extra input work, net heat and initial-corrected mechanical storage
Keep initial absolute energy offset visible; include residual and time-refinement evidence
